name: browser-use
headline: SwiftUI-Agent-Skill - SwiftUI Best Practices for AI
short_description: Add expert SwiftUI best practices guidance to your AI coding tool. Benefits developers by improving SwiftUI API usage, state management, and performance. Integrates with any AI coding tool supporting the Agent Skills open format.
author: AvdLee

sections.overview:
SwiftUI-Agent-Skill is an open-format agent skill that integrates SwiftUI expertise into AI coding tools like Claude and Cursor. It guides developers on proper SwiftUI API usage, state management patterns, and performance optimization. The skill includes comprehensive references on navigation, appearance, animations, gestures, and accessibility, along with a maintenance workflow that keeps SwiftUI API information current by scanning for deprecations. Developers benefit from real-time best practice recommendations that help write more idiomatic and efficient SwiftUI code.
Review existing SwiftUI code for state management and modern API improvements.
Refactor SwiftUI views to enhance performance and maintainability.
Implement best practices for lists, sheets, and navigation in SwiftUI applications.
Optimize image handling and layout patterns for better performance.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/AvdLee/SwiftUI-Agent-Skill`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
